purpose: Explicit display-only adoption of remote V3 TTS fields; property IDs/delegates/values remain unchanged.

literalChanges.before: "When enabled, TTS requests use the native Volcengine V1 HTTP non-streaming protocol (Authorization: Bearer;token and the app/user/audio/request structure)."
literalChanges.after: "Selects V1 or V3 HTTP unidirectional synthesis (including Agent Plan) by API URL. Both collect all audio before playback; existing settings are not migrated automatically."

literalChanges.before: "The documented request header is: Authorization: Bearer;{token}"
literalChanges.after: "V1 uses your legacy token; its HTTP header is Authorization: Bearer; followed by the token. V3 uses the corresponding speech-service API key (X-Api-Key). Agent Plan requires its dedicated API key; do not reuse the old token."

literalChanges.before: "The app.appid field in the V1 request body."
literalChanges.after: "V1 requires app.appid. V3 API-key authentication does not use it, so it may be blank. Switching protocols does not clear the old value."

literalChanges.before: "Written to the X-Api-Resource-Id request header. Supported entries: seed-tts-1.0 / seed-tts-1.0-concurr / seed-tts-2.0 / seed-icl-1.0 / seed-icl-1.0-concurr / seed-icl-2.0"
literalChanges.after: "Written to the X-Api-Resource-Id request header. The resource and voice must be enabled and authorized; synthesis voices from model 2.0 use V3. Accepted values include seed-tts-1.0 / seed-tts-1.0-concurr / seed-tts-2.0 / seed-icl-1.0 / seed-icl-1.0-concurr / seed-icl-2.0."
"Maps to voice_type in V1 and speaker in V3. It must match the resource ID and account authorization; the old voice is not replaced automatically."

literalChanges.before: "Write the TTS Volc Dedicated Additions JSON verbatim to request.extra_param as a string. Use a JSON object."
literalChanges.after: "Written to request.extra_param in V1 or req_params.additions in V3, both as JSON strings. Use parameters supported by the selected endpoint."

literalChanges.before: "V1 encoding. The current player supports only wav or pcm."
literalChanges.after: "Supports wav or pcm only. V1 requests the selected format unchanged. V3 always receives PCM and wraps it as selected here, retaining the current player."
"Recommended values: 8000 / 16000 / 24000 Hz. V3 also supports 22050 Hz; arbitrary integer sample rates are not accepted by V3."
"V1 supports 0.1–2.0 times normal; V3 supports 0.5–2.0 (1.0 is normal). A value that is too low after switching to V3 produces an error and is not changed automatically."

literalChanges.before: "Uses native Volcengine V1 parameters to test the fixed text “At your service, traveler!”"
literalChanges.after: "Tests the fixed phrase “At your service, traveler!” using the current API URL and credential. Real synthesis may incur charges."
